Risk Description: Model Overfitting: The LSTM model may "memorize" historical noise instead of general patterns, leading to poor live performance.
Mitigation Strategy: Implement Early Stopping, Dropout layers, and L2 Regularization during training. Validate using K-fold cross-validation on different time periods.

Risk Description: API Latency: High response times from the Python ML microservice could delay chart rendering beyond the 8-second NFR.
Mitigation Strategy: Use FastAPI for its asynchronous capabilities. Implement caching for frequently requested tickers to reduce redundant computation.

Risk Description: Data Source Volatility: Changes or outages in the Yahoo Finance API (External Data Layer) could break the data pipeline.
Mitigation Strategy: Implement robust exception handling in the data fetching script. Design a fallback mechanism to use local cached data if the API is unreachable.

Risk Description: Deployment Incompatibility: Differences between local development and cloud environments (Vercel/AWS) may cause service failures.
Mitigation Strategy: Use Docker containerization for both the Next.js frontend and Python backend to ensure environment parity across all stages.

Risk Description: Security Vulnerabilities: Unauthorized access to user accounts or data during transmission between microservices.
Mitigation Strategy: Enforce HTTPS for all API communication and implement JWT (JSON Web Tokens) for secure authentication between layers.
